title: Mipo and the Missing Rainbow Color
audience: Children 2-7 (works up to ~9). English narration, simple words, calm pace, interactive pauses.
missing_color_note: The missing color is PURPLE. It appears nowhere on Mipo. Until the wand tap in 'The tap: MAGIC!' the rainbow has no purple stripe, purple things (castle roofs, crystals, purple flowers) are soft grey and the world is slightly muted. Afterwards purple is restored everywhere.
storyboard_reference: None yet (the 30 s Shorts animatic covers the core beats).
learning_goals: Rainbow colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple
Naming feelings: sad, scared, brave, happy
Asking for help, helping others, taking turns
emotional_arc: sad -> calmer -> hopeful -> brave -> caring -> brave together -> kind -> joyful

voice.character: narrator (gentle storyteller) + Mipo + Blue Bird + Bunny + Baby Deer + Little Purple
voice.description: Narrator: warm, friendly storyteller. Mipo: warm, cheerful young boy (6-7). Friends: small, sweet, distinct. Clear American English, calm pace with pauses for kids to answer.
voice.consistency: Each character always uses the same ElevenLabs voice (production/voices.json). Never change a character's voice between episodes.

end_card.subtitle: Mipo's Magical World
end_card.note: Draw in the editor; the last 20 s also leave room for YouTube end-screen elements.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Hi, friends! I'm Mipo!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Look at my rainbow... Uh-oh!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: One color is missing! Will you help me find it?

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Yay! Let's go!

narration.text: Good morning, Mipo! The sun is up, and the birds are singing.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Good morning, sunshine!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Oh no... where is the purple?

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: The purple stripe is gone. And look... the purple flowers are grey.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Mipo feels sad. That's okay. Everybody feels sad sometimes.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Let's take a big breath with Mipo. Smell the flower...

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: ...and blow out the candle. One more time!
narration.delivery: slow, calm, playful at the end

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: I feel a little better now.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Hello, Blue Bird. The rainbow lost its purple.

narration.speaker: bird
narration.text: Tweet! Don't worry, Mipo. We can find it together!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Look! Mipo's magic wand is glowing!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: A sparkle trail! It will show us the way!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Don't worry, rainbow. I'll bring your purple back!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Mipo feels brave now.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Are you ready, friends? Let's follow the sparkles!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Let's go!

narration.text: Welcome to the Red Strawberry Garden! Everything here is... red!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Can you say red? ...Red!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Will you come with us?

narration.speaker: bunny

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Now Mipo has two friends. Friends make adventures more fun!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Helping a friend feels warm and happy inside.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Whoa! Roll, pumpkin, roll!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Look! A purple sparkle! It went that way!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Yellow, yellow, like the sun!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Can you find something yellow where you are?
narration.delivery: inviting the viewer; leave a pause after

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Hmm... the sunflowers are so tall. I can't see the sparkles!

narration.speaker: deer
narration.text: Hello! I'm tall. Maybe I can help!

narration.speaker: deer
narration.text: I see the sparkles! They are going into the Green Forest.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Thank you, Deer! Will you come too?

narration.speaker: deer
narration.text: Yes! Let's take turns leading the way.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Taking turns is a kind thing to do.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: This is the Whispering Forest. Green leaves, green moss... green everywhere!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: It's a little dark in here... I feel a bit scared.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: When we feel scared, we can hold a friend's hand.

narration.speaker: bunny
narration.text: We're right here, Mipo.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Together... I feel brave!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Look! The fireflies are lighting the way!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Hellooo!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: ...hellooo... Can you say hello with Mipo? Hellooo!
narration.delivery: the first word soft like an echo, then inviting the viewer

narration.speaker: bird
narration.text: Tweet! The frog says a little purple drop went to the river!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Blue, blue... the river is blue!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: And the sky is blue too!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Let's count the stones as we hop! One... two... three...

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: ...four... five... six!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Slow and careful. Good job, friends!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: The sparkles go into that cave!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: The crystals here should be purple... but they are grey.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Shh... listen. Someone is crying.

narration.speaker: little_purple
narration.text: I'm the purple. I felt so small... I thought nobody would miss me.
narration.delivery: tiny, soft, shy, a little sad

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: We missed you so much! The rainbow needs you!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Every color is important. And every friend is important too.

narration.speaker: bunny
narration.text: We need you!

narration.speaker: deer
narration.text: You make the flowers pretty!

narration.speaker: bird
narration.text: Tweet, tweet! Come home!

narration.speaker: little_purple
narration.text: Really? Okay! Let's go home!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Mipo and his friends climb to the top of Rainbow Hill.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Are you ready, Little Purple?

narration.speaker: little_purple
narration.text: Ready!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Friends at home, count with me!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Three... two... one!
narration.delivery: big countdown, one number per second

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: MAGIC!
narration.delivery: joyful, the big moment; land the word on the tap

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Swish! The purple goes back into the rainbow!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: The rainbow is complete!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Hooray! We did it!

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Hooray for Mipo and his friends!

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue... and purple!
narration.delivery: sing-song, one color per beat, slow

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Today I felt sad, then brave, then happy! And my friends helped me.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Remember: it's okay to feel sad, friends help each other, and every color is important.

narration.speaker: mipo
narration.text: Thank you for helping me, friends! See you next magic moment!
